_comment: Settings for scripts/ollama_bridge.py. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. Guide: documentation/OLLAMA_LOCAL_MODELS_GUIDE.md
_ollama_url: Must stay a loopback address (127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost). The bridge refuses any other host.
_default_model: Used when --model is not given. List the installed models with: .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\ollama_bridge.py models
_context_tokens: num_ctx sent with every request (capped at the model's own limit). Larger values need more memory.
_options: Ollama options for every model, e.g. {"temperature": 0.2}. Empty means each model's own defaults.
_policy: Glob patterns relative to the repository root. The fixed rules in the script always win: .git, .venv, secrets and .ollama-bridge stay hidden; scripts/, .github/, docs/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, build.py, manage.py, requirements.txt and generated root pages stay read-only.
_validate_commands: Run in order by apply and check; {python} is the project .venv interpreter. A failure restores the files.
